5-minute team walkthrough

Demonstrate the full response loop

  1. 1
    Start with the situation map

    Show scattered reports combined into one view with verification and freshness.

  2. 2
    Open a map incident

    Explain the uncertainty, duplicate signals and why a priority was suggested.

  3. 3
    Submit a waterlogging report

    Add access disruption and medical impact to show explainable analysis.

  4. 4
    Review it in Coordination

    Verify the report, assign a resource and change response status.

  5. 5
    Check a route

    Show a warning and lower-risk alternative without claiming either route is safe.

  6. 6
    Toggle Offline

    Submit another report, then reconnect and show the queued item synchronise.
